French football star Kylian Mbappé is facing backlash in China after reportedly joking about former Chinese leader Mao Zedong during a talk show appearance. Two Chinese brands have reportedly dropped the Real Madrid forward as their brand ambassador amid the growing controversy.
The Palki Sharma Show is a news, opinions and current affairs show from IGR.
The show covers the biggest stories of our time and helps the audience make sense of an increasingly complex world.
The show is anchored by Palki Sharma, Founder, IGR.
